text: It moves! It has soggy eyes though. So soggy.
You! Soggy! Your friends ran off. The bear ate one. His guts are sogging up ahead.
The other one took your stuff. She went towards the festering man.
The festering man knows. Find him.
Another! The sea spat you out too, huh?
Ah, the sodden one returns.
Your language is foreign to me. Do you speak the common tongue?
Aye. My flesh was unwelcome even in her hungry gullet, thanks be.
[narrate]He shakes his head and points to the library upstairs.[/narrate]
I知 afraid my cookpot is also empty. But if you find 3 cuts of goblin flesh you値l feed us both! [narrate]He holds up 3 fingers[/narrate]
One of my mates came this way. Have you seen her?
Ah yes, she was impatient to leave my little island. Looking for the bridge key, hee hee!
I buried it long ago though. Your friend gave me her shiny hammer for a spade and a clue!
Where did she go?
A clue about the bridge key?
Trade?
What did you say about the cookpot?
Last I saw of her she was walking the beach to the west. She may have sought shelter from the rain in the caves alone the shore.
A little scribble on a scrap. She値l need the shovel to dig it up.
Yes yes! Do you have something to trade too?
Find 3 cuts of goblin flesh you値l feed us both! [narrate]He holds up 3 fingers[/narrate]
